Correction learning now works in Electron apps whose accessibility support is switched off — which is most of them, most of the time, including Claude Desktop. Chromium keeps its accessibility tree disabled until an assistive tool shows up, so whether Parley could watch your pasted text depended on whether something else had happened to switch it on that day. Parley now asks the app to enable it (Electron's own mechanism for exactly this), watches, and switches it back off when done. Watching also tells apart "the field is briefly unreadable" from "you switched to another app", so neither ends the watch prematurely.
